messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick check-in  we've got provisional slot and audience: "Platform teams" + "product infra". Proposal: webinar titled 'Inference playbook: optimizing cost & latency for production' — okay to lock?
Diego (Growth): Love it. Can we angle one promo line toward SREs? "Reduce token spend without regressions" maybe.
Priya (Content): I'll A/B test two headline variants on the registration page. Drafts in 2hrs.
Rita (Solutions Engineer): Can volunteer a short customer mini-case (2 slides) showing dedup cache -> 30% token savings. Need to confirm customer ok.
Maya (Marketing): Good. Rehearsal slots: Wed 8:30 PT tech check (mics + screenshare), Thu 9:00 PT dress. Who's available?
Priya (Content): Thu dress works best for my calendar.
Diego (Growth): Wed tech check ok. Thu might conflict but I'll make the last 30min.
Rita (Solutions Engineer): Both ok.
OpsBot: Calendar events created: Tech check Wed 2024-03-13 08:30 PT, Dress Thu 2024-03-14 09:00 PT. Links posted to calendar invites.
Maya (Marketing): Demo plan (short): 1) precomputed benchmark screenshots, 2) live call to non-prod endpoint, 3) fallback screenshot. Keep live calls to <90s. Any objections?
Rita (Solutions Engineer): Agree. I'll prepare a test endpoint (read-only key) and a curl snippet. Also baking in a quick fallback script:
```
# fallback script to show precomputed numbers if live call fails
if curl --max-time 5 -sS $TEST_ENDPOINT | grep -q "token_count"; then
  echo "live success"
else
  cat fallback.json
fi
```
Maya (Marketing): Love that. Promo timeline from Diego?
Diego (Growth): 3 emails + social: Announcement (2 weeks out), Benchmark preview (5 days out), Last chance (24h). Also a short LinkedIn carousel showing the 1-slide cost vs latency tradeoff.
Priya (Content): Registration form draft (please review):
```
Name
Email
Company
Primary role (dropdown)
Main inference pain (multi-select)
Would you like a one-pager on our benchmark methodology? (checkbox)
```
Maya (Marketing): Add UTM field and a consent checkbox for marketing follow-up. Also route "Primary role" values to SDR queue mapping.
Diego (Growth): I'll wire the routing rules in Pardot and create a segment for "Platform" + "High spend" pain responses.
Rita (Solutions Engineer): For the slide deck, I suggest a 'what not to do' slide showing naive batching pitfalls. I'll sketch one.
Priya (Content): Draft 30s landing headline: "Practical inference tradeoffs: cut costs, keep latency". Longer 90s pitch in drive.
Maya (Marketing): Can we finalize abstracts + landing copy EOD tomorrow? Also need speaker one-pagers (3 bullets of talking points each).
Priya (Content): I'll drop speaker bullets and TL;DR slides into Drive by EOD.
Maya (Marketing): Action items: Maya: publish invites + webinar page; Diego: promo calendar + ad copy; Priya: landing + speaker bullets; Rita: test endpoint + demo screenshots. Mark finished here when done.
Rita (Solutions Engineer): Test endpoint provisioned and curl example posted to Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake-link-demo
Diego (Growth): Promo calendar set. Draft subject lines posted in Docs.
Priya (Content): Landing copy + speaker bullets uploaded (v1). Link: https://drive.google.com/fake-link-copy
Maya (Marketing): Great progress. One last ask: blocking checklist for dress rehearsal (audio, screen sharing, host controls, fallback slide, recording node). I'll paste a short one in the channel later. :rocket:
Maya (Marketing): [later] Blocking checklist: 1) Confirm all presenters have host access; 2) Verify slides render in presenter view; 3) Verify test key is reachable from webinar VM; 4) Upload fallback screenshots to CDN; 5) Confirm recording goes to shared drive.
Diego (Growth): Noted. I'll confirm ad creatives are queued after abstracts final.
OpsBot: Webinar page live (draft) at https://events.redwood.fake/practical-inference-playbook
Maya (Marketing): Closing thread for now  will reopen if anything blocks. Thanks team! :clap:
